Welcome to the subverse for TwitchDatesPokemon!

If you've found your way here, then you're probably familiar with the very popular TwitchPlaysPokemon, an experiment where Twitch members controlled a game of Pokemon using the chat to enter commands. The event spawned a plethora of fan content, including art, comics, fanfics, and games. One such work of art, a depiction of what TPP would look like as a dating sim, garnered some attention.

Enter TwitchDatesPokemon, a fully-fledged Visual Novel based on that fanart of TPP. We decided to take the concept of a TPP dating sim and roll with it. We've been working very hard to bring you the very best game we can. We like to call ourselves Tablefort Studios.

Looking for download links? Week 1 is available right here!

--DOWNLOAD LINKS--

WINDOWS Installer -- http://www.tablefortstudios.com/download?file=TDP-Week1-windows-latest

WINDOWS, MAC, LINUX ZIP -- http://tablefortstudios.com/download?file=TDP-Week1-zip-latest

FAQ

Q: Who's in charge of this thing?

A: Our project lead is Nozzivix. We have a team consisting of writers (lead by Zekiradrake), artists (lead by Flywoods, who made the original art), a couple musicians led by (eugeneration), one programmer (/u/kichithewolf), and a few editors (who need no master). These updates to the sub are all written by blitzmckrieg.

Q: What's a Visual Novel?

A: A Visual Novel is a type of video game popular in Japan. It has an emphasis on story and character development over gameplay, which usually consists of just clicking through text.

Q: I heard Visual Novels have erotic content, does this game have any?

A: No, this is a family-friendly game. (And not all Visual Novels have that stuff, by the way)

Q: But it's technically a dating sim, right?

A: Well, yeah. The gameplay will consist of clicking through text, with you having to make many decisions that alter the course of the narrative. You'll have the chance to go out with everyone in the main cast and follow their story like a novel. Unless you mess up, that is.

Q: When is the game coming out?

A: Our first release, TwitchDatesPokemon Week 1, is already out! As for when the whole thing is going to be done, well, we just don't know that yet.

Q: Is [insert character from TPP] going to be in the game?

A: We're keeping our cast of characters strictly to those from gens 1 and 2. Expect to see most of the main characters from those gens in some capacity. ~~Zexy is going to have his own detective spin-off.~~

Q: Can I help?

A: Glad you asked. Most positions have been filled by this point, but there are always a few hats that need wearing.

If you're interested and want to help out, you can send a PM to this account (don't be shy!).

Q: How can I keep up with what you guys are doing?

A: By subscribing to this very subverse! We try to keep it updated semi-regularly (whether we actually do or not is debatable), so it's a great way to keep up with things. I also update this very post whenever things change, so the information is always relevant. Check back here from time to time just in case. And trust me, if this project ever died, we would make a post about it. So if there's isn't such a post, then that means everything is running smoothly!

Q: What platforms will it be available on?

A: Right now it's going to be coming to Windows, Mac, and Linux with a possible port to Android.

Thank you so much for looking into who we are, we hope we won't disappoint! If you have any questions, feel free to reply to this post or send us a PM.

As a side note, don't be intimidated. Most of us are just guys and girls in our late teens to early twenties, and all of us are huge nerds. If you're even considering joining this project, odds are you'll fit in great.

Until next time!
